name: CFI Holding S.A.
summary: CFI Holding S.A. is a Polish company primarily involved in the construction sector. Its diversified operations span several key areas: TBS, commercial real estate, hospitality (hotels and restaurants), health and wellness services, and the chemical industry. The company's business activities include leasing residential and commercial properties, along with construction equipment. Furthermore, it supplies various chemicals, such as fertilizers, crop protection agents, and dyes. Beyond this, CFI Holding manages hotels, restaurants, and catering services, as well as health and fitness facilities like swimming pools, saunas, spas, and gyms. It also offers transportation solutions. Its portfolio further extends to property management, financial leasing, and money brokerage. Established in 1988, CFI Holding S.A. maintains its headquarters in Wroclaw, Poland.
